item.title: Optimal execution in a fractional setting with reinforcement learning
item.description: arXiv:2611.11373v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We consider the problem of optimal liquidation with linear market impact, as in the seminal work of Almgren and Chriss, but with an asset driven by a fractional Brownian motion. For $H \neq 1/2$, we observe that the deterministic solution given by Almgren and Chriss is no longer optimal. We develop a strategy to exploit the information induced by the correlation between price increments. The strategy is derived from a policy gradient algorithm, parameterized by a neural network, trained to maximise the CARA utility, for which our method allows for significant improvements.
item.dc:creator: Matthieu Garcin, Jiang Pu, Thomas Verrier
